description: Read Thunderbird's console. Beta builds only - this exists so the bridge can see platform errors, which never reach the add-on's own event log.

functions.name: getMessages
functions.description: Console messages captured so far, oldest first. Seeded from the platform's own backlog the first time it is called, so messages from before the bridge started are included.

sinceSeq.description: Return only messages with a higher seq. Omit for everything held.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Drop everything held, so the next capture starts from a known point.
